import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_precond (graph : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Decidable edge test. -/
def hasEdgeB (g : TopoGraph) (w u : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (w < g.adj.size) && (g.adj.getD w #[]).toList.any (fun x => x == u)

/-- `true` iff `u` already occurs in the emitted prefix (i.e. `u` is visited). -/
def memB (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range out.size).any fun i => out.getD i 0 == u

/-- `true` iff no *unvisited* `w` has an edge `w → u`, i.e. `u`'s in-degree in the
remaining subgraph is zero. -/
def noPredB (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).all fun w => memB out w || !hasEdgeB g w u

/-- Least unvisited source, if any. -/
def pickSource (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).find? fun u => !memB out u && noPredB g out u

/-- Kahn's algorithm main loop (selection-scan variant): repeatedly extract a node
whose remaining in-degree is zero; if none exists while nodes remain, report a cycle. -/
def kahnGo (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (out : Array Nat) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => some out
  | fuel + 1 =>
      match pickSource g out with
      | none => none
      | some u => kahnGo g fuel (out.push u)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def topological_sort (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  kahnGo graph graph.adj.size #[]
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_postcond (graph : TopoGraph) (result : Option (Array Nat))
    (_ : topological_sort_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle ∧
      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace Kahn

theorem agetD_eq (a : Array Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < a.size) : a.getD i 0 = a[i] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem lgetD_eq (p : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < p.length) : p.getD i 0 = p[i] := by
  simp [List.getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h]

theorem getD_push_lt (out : Array Nat) (u i : Nat) (h : i < out.size) :
    (out.push u).getD i 0 = out.getD i 0 := by
  have h2 : i < (out.push u).size := by rw [Array.size_push]; omega
  rw [agetD_eq _ _ h2, agetD_eq _ _ h]
  simp [Array.getElem_push_lt, h]

theorem getD_push_eq (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat) :
    (out.push u).getD out.size 0 = u := by
  have h2 : out.size < (out.push u).size := by rw [Array.size_push]; omega
  rw [agetD_eq _ _ h2]
  simp

theorem memB_iff (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat) :
    memB out u = true ↔ ∃ i, i < out.size ∧ out.getD i 0 = u := by
  simp [memB, List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]

theorem hasEdgeB_iff (g : TopoGraph) (w u : Nat) :
    hasEdgeB g w u = true ↔ g.has_edge w u := by
  rw [hasEdgeB, TopoGraph.has_edge, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff,
    List.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, x, hx, hxu⟩
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    rw [← beq_iff_eq.mp hxu]
    exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hx
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h1, u, Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr h2, beq_self_eq_true u⟩

theorem noPredB_iff (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat) :
    noPredB g out u = true ↔
      ∀ w, w < g.adj.size → g.has_edge w u → memB out w = true := by
  constructor
  · intro h w hw he
    have h1 := (List.all_eq_true.mp h) w (List.mem_range.mpr hw)
    rcases Bool.or_eq_true _ _ |>.mp h1 with h2 | h2
    · exact h2
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true'] at h2
      rw [(hasEdgeB_iff g w u).mpr he] at h2
      exact absurd h2 (by simp)
  · intro h
    rw [noPredB, List.all_eq_true]
    intro w hw
    cases h1 : hasEdgeB g w u with
    | false => simp
    | true => simp [h w (List.mem_range.mp hw) ((hasEdgeB_iff g w u).mp h1)]

theorem pickSource_some (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat)
    (h : pickSource g out = some u) :
    u < g.adj.size ∧ memB out u = false ∧ noPredB g out u = true := by
  have h1 := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h
  have h2 := List.find?_some h
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h2
  exact ⟨List.mem_range.mp h1, h2.1, h2.2⟩

theorem pickSource_none (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat)
    (h : pickSource g out = none) :
    ∀ u, u < g.adj.size → memB out u = false → noPredB g out u = false := by
  intro u hu hm
  have h1 := List.find?_eq_none.mp h u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true', hm, true_and] at h1
  simpa using h1

structure Inv (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (out : Array Nat) : Prop where
  hs : out.size + fuel = g.adj.size
  hrange : ∀ i, i < out.size → out.getD i 0 < g.adj.size
  hnodup : ∀ i j, i < out.size → j < out.size → i ≠ j → out.getD i 0 ≠ out.getD j 0
  hpred : ∀ j, j < out.size → ∀ w, g.has_edge w (out.getD j 0) → ∃ i, i < j ∧ out.getD i 0 = w

theorem inv_init (g : TopoGraph) : Inv g g.adj.size #[] where
  hs := by simp
  hrange := by intro i hi; simp at hi
  hnodup := by intro i j hi _ _; simp at hi
  hpred := by intro j hj; simp at hj

theorem inv_step (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (out : Array Nat) (u : Nat)
    (inv : Inv g (fuel + 1) out) (hp : pickSource g out = some u) :
    Inv g fuel (out.push u) := by
  obtain ⟨hu, hmu, hnp⟩ := pickSource_some g out u hp
  have hsz : (out.push u).size = out.size + 1 := Array.size_push ..
  constructor
  · have := inv.hs; omega
  · intro i hi
    rw [hsz] at hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i out.size with h | h
    · rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h]; exact inv.hrange i h
    · have : i = out.size := by omega
      subst this
      rw [getD_push_eq]; exact hu
  · intro i j hi hj hij
    rw [hsz] at hi hj
    have key : ∀ k, k < out.size → out.getD k 0 ≠ u := by
      intro k hk hc
      have : memB out u = true := (memB_iff out u).mpr ⟨k, hk, hc⟩
      rw [hmu] at this; exact Bool.noConfusion this
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i out.size with h1 | h1 <;> rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j out.size with h2 | h2
    · rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h1, getD_push_lt _ _ _ h2]; exact inv.hnodup i j h1 h2 hij
    · have hj' : j = out.size := by omega
      subst hj'
      rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h1, getD_push_eq]; exact key i h1
    · have hi' : i = out.size := by omega
      subst hi'
      rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h2, getD_push_eq]
      exact fun hc => key j h2 hc.symm
    · omega
  · intro j hj w he
    rw [hsz] at hj
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j out.size with h1 | h1
    · rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ h1] at he
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hie⟩ := inv.hpred j h1 w he
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ (by omega)]; exact hie⟩
    · have hj' : j = out.size := by omega
      subst hj'
      rw [getD_push_eq] at he
      have hw : w < g.adj.size := he.1
      have := (noPredB_iff g out u).mp hnp w hw he
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hie⟩ := (memB_iff out w).mp this
      exact ⟨i, hi, by rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ hi]; exact hie⟩

theorem surj_of_inj (n : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) (hlt : ∀ i, i < n → f i < n)
    (hinj : ∀ i j, i < n → j < n → i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j) :
    ∀ m, m < n → ∃ i, i < n ∧ f i = m := by
  intro m hm
  have hinj' : Set.InjOn f (Finset.range n) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    by_contra hne
    exact hinj a b (Finset.mem_range.mp ha) (Finset.mem_range.mp hb) hne hab
  have himg : (Finset.range n).image f = Finset.range n := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := hx
      exact hfi ▸ hlt i hi
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj']
  have hmem : m ∈ (Finset.range n).image f := by
    rw [himg]; exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hm
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩

theorem no_cycle_of_topo (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat)
    (hsurj : ∀ v, v < g.adj.size → ∃ k, k < out.size ∧ out.getD k 0 = v)
    (hstrict : ∀ i j, i < out.size → j < out.size →
        g.has_edge (out.getD i 0) (out.getD j 0) → i < j) :
    ¬ g.graph_has_cycle := by
  rintro ⟨p, ⟨hlen0, hedges⟩, hlen1, hhl⟩
  have hpos0 : ∀ v : Nat, ∃ k, v < g.adj.size → (k < out.size ∧ out.getD k 0 = v) := by
    intro v
    by_cases hv : v < g.adj.size
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hsurj v hv; exact ⟨k, fun _ => hk⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun hc => absurd hc hv⟩
  choose pos hpos using hpos0
  have hlast : p.getD 0 0 = p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 := by
    have h0 : (0 : Nat) < p.length := hlen0
    have h1 : p.length - 1 < p.length := by omega
    rw [lgetD_eq p 0 h0, lgetD_eq p (p.length - 1) h1]
    rw [List.head?_eq_getElem?, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem h0, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1] at hhl
    exact Option.some.inj hhl
  have hnode : ∀ i, i < p.length → p.getD i 0 < g.adj.size := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hi' : i + 1 < p.length
    · exact (hedges i hi').1
    · have hie : i = p.length - 1 := by omega
      subst hie
      rw [← hlast]
      exact (hedges 0 (by omega)).1
  have hstepp : ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → pos (p.getD i 0) < pos (p.getD (i + 1) 0) := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 := hpos _ (hnode i (by omega))
    have h2 := hpos _ (hnode (i + 1) hi)
    apply hstrict _ _ h1.1 h2.1
    rw [h1.2, h2.2]
    exact hedges i hi
  have chain : ∀ d i, i + d + 1 < p.length → pos (p.getD i 0) < pos (p.getD (i + d + 1) 0) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => intro i hi; exact hstepp i (by omega)
    | succ d ih =>
      intro i hi
      have e : i + (d + 1) + 1 = (i + d + 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [e]
      exact lt_trans (ih i (by omega)) (hstepp (i + d + 1) (by omega))
  have hfin := chain (p.length - 2) 0 (by omega)
  rw [show 0 + (p.length - 2) + 1 = p.length - 1 by omega, ← hlast] at hfin
  exact lt_irrefl _ hfin

theorem topo_of_inv (g : TopoGraph) (out : Array Nat) (inv : Inv g 0 out) :
    g.is_topological_ordering out ∧ ¬ g.graph_has_cycle := by
  have hsize : out.size = g.adj.size := by have := inv.hs; omega
  have hsurj : ∀ v, v < g.adj.size → ∃ k, k < out.size ∧ out.getD k 0 = v := by
    intro v hv
    exact surj_of_inj out.size (fun i => out.getD i 0)
      (fun i hi => by rw [hsize]; exact inv.hrange i hi)
      (fun i j hi hj hij => inv.hnodup i j hi hj hij) v (by omega)
  have hstrict : ∀ i j, i < out.size → j < out.size →
      g.has_edge (out.getD i 0) (out.getD j 0) → i < j := by
    intro i j hi hj he
    obtain ⟨i', hi', hie⟩ := inv.hpred j hj (out.getD i 0) he
    by_cases hne : i' = i
    · omega
    · exact absurd hie (inv.hnodup i' i (by omega) hi hne)
  refine ⟨⟨hsize, hsurj, inv.hnodup, ?_⟩, no_cycle_of_topo g out hsurj hstrict⟩
  intro i j hji hi he
  have := hstrict i j hi (by omega) he
  omega

theorem stuck_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (fuel : Nat) (out : Array Nat)
    (inv : Inv g (fuel + 1) out) (h : pickSource g out = none) :
    g.graph_has_cycle := by
  have hsz : out.size < g.adj.size := by have := inv.hs; omega
  have hex : ∃ u, u < g.adj.size ∧ memB out u = false := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have hsub : Finset.range g.adj.size ⊆ (Finset.range out.size).image (fun i => out.getD i 0) := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' := Finset.mem_range.mp hx
      have hmem : memB out x = true := by
        cases hb : memB out x with
        | false => exact absurd hb (hc x hx')
        | true => rfl
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hie⟩ := (memB_iff out x).mp hmem
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, hie⟩
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_range] at hcard
    have h2 := le_trans hcard (Finset.card_image_le)
    rw [Finset.card_range] at h2
    omega
  have hstep : ∀ u, u < g.adj.size → memB out u = false →
      ∃ w, w < g.adj.size ∧ memB out w = false ∧ g.has_edge w u := by
    intro u hu hm
    have hnp := pickSource_none g out h u hu hm
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have : noPredB g out u = true := by
      rw [noPredB_iff]
      intro w hw he
      cases hb : memB out w with
      | false => exact absurd he (hcon w hw hb)
      | true => rfl
    rw [this] at hnp; exact Bool.noConfusion hnp
  have hf0 : ∀ u, ∃ w, (u < g.adj.size ∧ memB out u = false) →
      (w < g.adj.size ∧ memB out w = false ∧ g.has_edge w u) := by
    intro u
    by_cases hu : u < g.adj.size ∧ memB out u = false
    · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hstep u hu.1 hu.2
      exact ⟨w, fun _ => hw⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun hcon => absurd hcon hu⟩
  choose f hf using hf0
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hm₀⟩ := hex
  have hiter : ∀ k, f^[k] u₀ < g.adj.size ∧ memB out (f^[k] u₀) = false := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨hu₀, hm₀⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact ⟨(hf _ ih).1, (hf _ ih).2.1⟩
  have hedge : ∀ k, g.has_edge (f^[k + 1] u₀) (f^[k] u₀) := by
    intro k
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact (hf _ (hiter k)).2.2
  have main : ∀ a b, a < b → f^[a] u₀ = f^[b] u₀ → g.graph_has_cycle := by
    intro a b hab heq
    refine ⟨(List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]; omega
    · intro i hi
      simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at hi
      have e1 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀)).getD i 0
          = f^[b - i] u₀ := by
        rw [lgetD_eq _ _ (by simp; omega)]
        simp
      have e2 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀)).getD (i + 1) 0
          = f^[b - (i + 1)] u₀ := by
        rw [lgetD_eq _ _ (by simp; omega)]
        simp
      rw [e1, e2]
      have e3 : b - i = (b - (i + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [e3]
      exact hedge (b - (i + 1))
    · simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]; omega
    · have hlen : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀)).length = b - a + 1 := by
        simp
      have h0 : (0 : Nat) < ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀)).length := by
        omega
      have h1 : ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀)).length - 1 <
          ((List.range (b - a + 1)).map (fun t => f^[b - t] u₀)).length := by omega
      rw [List.head?_eq_getElem?, List.getLast?_eq_getElem?,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem h0, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1]
      congr 1
      rw [← lgetD_eq _ _ h0, ← lgetD_eq _ _ h1]
      rw [lgetD_eq _ _ h0, lgetD_eq _ _ h1]
      simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, hlen]
      rw [show b - 0 = b by omega, show b - (b - a + 1 - 1) = a by omega]
      exact heq.symm
  obtain ⟨a, _, b, _, hab, heq⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to
      (s := Finset.range (g.adj.size + 1)) (t := Finset.range g.adj.size)
      (f := fun k => f^[k] u₀) (by simp)
      (fun x _ => Finset.mem_range.mpr (hiter x).1)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a b with hlt | hge
  · exact main a b hlt heq
  · exact main b a (by omega) heq.symm

theorem kahnGo_spec (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ fuel out, Inv g fuel out →
      (∀ order, kahnGo g fuel out = some order →
          g.is_topological_ordering order ∧ ¬ g.graph_has_cycle) ∧
      (kahnGo g fuel out = none → g.graph_has_cycle) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro out inv
    have he : kahnGo g 0 out = some out := rfl
    rw [he]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro order hord
      injection hord with hord
      subst hord
      exact topo_of_inv g out inv
    · intro hc; simp at hc
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro out inv
    cases hp : pickSource g out with
    | none =>
      have he : kahnGo g (fuel + 1) out = none := by simp [kahnGo, hp]
      rw [he]
      exact ⟨fun order hord => by simp at hord, fun _ => stuck_cycle g fuel out inv hp⟩
    | some u =>
      have he : kahnGo g (fuel + 1) out = kahnGo g fuel (out.push u) := by simp [kahnGo, hp]
      rw [he]
      exact ih _ (inv_step g fuel out u inv hp)

end Kahn
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem topological_sort_postcond_satisfied (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) :
    topological_sort_postcond graph (topological_sort graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hspec := Kahn.kahnGo_spec graph graph.adj.size #[] (Kahn.inv_init graph)
  show topological_sort_postcond graph (kahnGo graph graph.adj.size #[]) h_precond
  simp only [topological_sort_postcond]
  match hk : kahnGo graph graph.adj.size #[] with
  | none => exact hspec.2 hk
  | some order => exact ⟨(hspec.1 order hk).2, (hspec.1 order hk).1⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**LEAN VERIFIED.**

## What was wrong and what I changed

Both verifier errors were in proof scripts inside the `lemma` region; the algorithm, the invariant, and the specifications were already sound and were left untouched.

1. **`hasEdgeB_iff` (123:2, maxRecDepth in `simp`)** — the simp set contained `TopoGraph.has_edge.eq_1` (via unfolding `has_edge`) together with `Array.mem_def`, which rewrite into each other and loop. I replaced the `simp` with a directed `rw` into the `Bool.and_eq_true` / `decide_eq_true_iff` / `List.any_eq_true` normal form plus an explicit two-way `constructor` using `Array.mem_toList_iff`. I did **not** raise `maxRecDepth` — the loop is genuine, so that would only have moved the failure.

2. **`stuck_cycle` (360:12, "No goals to be solved")** — `simp; omega` on the `p.length > 0` goal: `simp` discharged it outright, leaving `omega` with nothing. Now `simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]; omega`, applied to that goal and its `length > 1` sibling at the same site so neither depends on how much `simp` happens to finish.

Size + surjectivity + distinctness together give the permutation property.
- **Cycle detection** — the `none` branch proves `graph_has_cycle` by *exhibiting* a path: `stuck_cycle` builds `(List.range (b-a+1)).map (fun t => f^[b-t] u₀)` from a pigeonholed repeat in the backward predecessor chain, and discharges `is_path`, `length > 1`, and `head? = getLast?`.
